what: In a grid mixing photo cells, text cells and empty cells, hovering one cell keeps photos only in cells with the same key (data-key) while the other photos switch off in .12s, so the fixed large photo behind the grid shows through between cells. Meanwhile each cell’s top and left 1px lines turn on in .5s, and text cells of the same work flip to an opposite-color panel (white panel, black text) in .12s. On leave it releases after 120ms so there is no flicker when crossing between cells

options.[data-fx-part=cell]: Cell — a cell with no hand raised turns the photo off and the line on. Give cells of the same work the same data-key
options.[data-fx-part=note]: Text cell — with the same key, it flips to the opposing color panel
options.linger: Time to release after leaving (ms), default 120
options.--fx-fade · --fx-line: Photo off / text-cell flip duration (default .12s) · cell line duration (default .5s)
options.fx:peek: Event the element fires when the key changes (detail.key, null when released) — set by whoever uses side decoration such as a cross mark
